draft_en.body:
Hi Intant,

You opened our mail on "10G Enterprise SFP Switch" (and "48 Port PoE Managed Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the Utepo-type industrial PoE positions in your Hikvision installations, we supply Marvell-based DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP (managed/unmanaged) and commercial 8-PoE L2+ switches from small lots, CE/RoHS; EAC by your side — which configuration do your projects use most?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
